name: lying straight-leg toe tap
description: A supine core drill that alternately lowers a straight leg toward the floor while the other leg stays raised.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight and lifted off the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your lower back gently pressed toward the floor.
Brace your abdomen and lower one leg until its toes lightly touch or nearly touch the floor.
Lift it back up as the other leg lowers, alternating without arching your lower back.
